Text:
Balances goods evenly among adjacent storages that also have Balancer.
<YellowHighlight>Connects only side-by-side on the same level</YellowHighlight> (full shared wall). Does not connect up or down.
Only for Storage buildings.
When two storages stand shoulder to shoulder, the goods flow as one.

Upgrades Balancer so storages connect if they <YellowHighlight>share any face</YellowHighlight>, including stacked up/down. Diagonals and corner-only contact do not count.
Requires Evenload Protocol. Only for Storage buildings.
From the lowest floor to the highest shelf, every crate finds its equal place.
This storage is not connected to any other balancer.
